scope: A fresh owner and complete guest journey tested locally, followed by a complete hosted demo stay with real WhatsApp consent, event delivery and one single-recipient campaign.

environments.local: Isolated staff and guest app copies, local Supabase and a disposable regression database clone. Local provider events and scanner results are explicitly synthetic.
environments.hosted: Demo Beach Hotel QA records only; existing hotel and guest records preserved. All actual QA sends targeted the user-selected test number. Synthetic payment records moved no external money.

checks.evidence: Created a fresh owner through signup, signed out and back in, and reached first-hotel setup. Hosted email confirmation delivery was not exercised.

Created business and hotel together; validated timezone/currency, identity/contact details, guest arrival instructions and operations defaults. Invalid timezone and database failure leave no orphan business; retries reuse the same hotel.
Created room type, room and rate plan, verified initial cleaning requirement, blocked and released availability with an audit reason.

Quoted and booked one night at INR 2500, allocated the clean room, generated a private guest-app link and saved guest arrival details. Repeated keyboard edits incremented versions without losing the confirmation. Hosted QA reservation also completed check-in through checkout; WhatsApp event links point to private guest-app stays.

Checked in the guest after cleaning. Separate stay/marketing choices, number verification and STOP were exercised with explicitly local inbound fixtures. The hosted guest independently confirmed both scopes through a real inbound WhatsApp message; source is guest_whatsapp.

Guest ordered two sandwiches; kitchen advanced placed/preparing/ready/served. Exactly one INR 420 charge, including tax, reached the folio. The hosted guest-token order also progressed to served with one INR 420 folio charge.

Guest service request created one linked task; starting/completing work updated both. Guest feedback persisted. Checkout created one new cleaning task; all three checklist steps were completed and room became clean. Hosted service, routed task, guest checkout-assistance request and automatic post-checkout cleaning also completed.

Unpaid checkout was blocked. Posted INR 2500 room nights plus INR 420 food. Offset INR 100 adjustment/credit, recorded synthetic INR 500 deposit plus INR 2420 settlement, issued invoice, downloaded ledger and reconciled INR 2920 receipts in hotel reports. No external money movement. Hosted stay separately settled the same INR 2920 total with QA-SYNTHETIC-NO-MONEY reference, issued an invoice and checked out. Hosted test records are synthetic financial entries, not payment-gateway transactions.

Completed checkout, confirmed room turnaround and post-checkout ordering restrictions. Fixed remaining nights staying blocked after early checkout; retained past-night history and original financial stay dates. Hosted early-departure hold was released and room cleaned. Automatic checkout message retains room history after release.

Uploaded a synthetic file through guest Edge Function and signed private storage. Staff access was denied while quarantined. Audit/review and document-approved event passed only after a local scanner fixture. Production malware scanning and a staff review screen are missing.

Submitted a real utility stay-update template and a static marketing template through the app. Meta approved both and synchronization marked them compatible. Migrated the same demo sender credential into the existing encrypted per-hotel store without changing the sender.

Assigned approved local fixtures to existing services, added Wellness category and custom Spa information service. Local Hi/category/service selections queued the assigned template with the private guest portal URL. Replay produced no duplicate reply; menu rows stayed within platform limits.

Local browser activated 15 rules; 14 domain event types were exercised. SQL validates all 23 catalog events and scheduler/security guards. Hosted QA activated nine compatible event types and produced 11 actual messages (service and checkout assistance are distinct requests). All 11 have delivered/read receipts and private guest-portal URLs.

Filtered by stay dates and guest name, selected exactly one contact and saved a template-backed draft. Hotel-local future schedule froze one recipient and did not dispatch early. Due fixture queued once; repeat dispatch did not duplicate. Local STOP prevented transport. Campaign cancellation confirmation remained visible after refresh.

Real single-recipient campaign launched after guest-origin marketing consent. Exactly one campaign message exists, campaign completed, and Meta receipt is read. Fixed the hosted worker omitting campaign expansion/claim capability; platform campaign processing enabled only after explicit user approval.

fixes: Atomic, idempotent first-business/hotel creation with rollback on failure.
Labeled responsive first-hotel setup with hotel currency and timezone.
New uninvited signup resolves first-time setup before the client follows the redirect.
Early checkout releases unused nights while preserving past occupied-night history.
Arrival form keeps confirmation state and takes its saved version directly from the server result.
Campaign controls preserve result confirmation across server version updates.
Reservation view points to the actual guest WhatsApp preferences; service-action copy acknowledges enabled notifications.
Checkout event and review-template room lookup retains the latest departed room after its inventory hold is released.
Hosted scheduled worker supports explicitly enabled campaign expansion and claims; disabled-by-default gating, authorization and failure behavior tested.

verification.browser: Chromium; staff/guest workflow, desktop and mobile onboarding screenshots inspected
verification.hosted_webhook_probe: Empty signed POST returned 200; real inbound verification subsequently recorded both permission scopes. No production inbound identity was fabricated.
verification.notification_tests_description: Ten transport tests plus four hosted worker campaign gating/orchestration tests.
verification.deployed_ui: Reservation, issued invoice, campaign read receipt, new onboarding and completed guest bill rendered successfully on deployed apps; screenshots inspected.

hosted_qa.unused_diagnostic_template: qa_connection_check_1795425857254 (submitted during webhook diagnosis; no diagnostic message sent)

remaining: Production malware scanner and staff document review screen. Only local scanner fixtures were used; no real guest document was marked clean without a scan.
Guest menu creation, grouping, custom services, template assignment, navigation and STOP were tested locally. This audit does not certify a live guest-menu selection exchange for the hosted hotel.
Hosted signup confirmation email delivery and independent-hotel Meta approval/onboarding were not certified by this audit.
